diffs.diff: header pin 5: part says RST, datasheet reading says RESET
diffs.evidence: Same signal, different label. The Pololu #1182 pinout photo shows the 5th logic-side pin printed as 'RST' (overlined, active low) between MS3 and SLP; the carrier schematic labels the net 'RST' going to A4988 pin 12 'RESET'. The model uses the board's silkscreen name and its description says 'RESET, active low'.

diffs.diff: header pin 6: part says SLP, datasheet reading says SLEEP
diffs.evidence: Same signal, different label. The Pololu pinout photo prints the 6th logic-side pin as 'SLP' (overlined); the carrier schematic shows net 'SLP' to A4988 pin 14 'SLEEP' with R3 100k pull-up to VDD, so the model marking it not required (awake if left open) is also right.

diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 3 V, datasheet reading 8 V
diffs.evidence: The two readings describe different supplies. Allegro A4988 datasheet, Electrical Characteristics: 'Load Supply Voltage Range VBB Operating 8 - 35 V' and 'Logic Supply Voltage Range VDD Operating 3 - 5.5 V'. The model's vmin/vmax (3-5.5 V) is the logic VDD that is wired to the microcontroller rail; VMOT 8-35 V is a separate motor supply and is documented as such in the pin description and build notes.
